scope: Real box storage; actual desktop client and production local memory service; isolated empty profile and database simulate a replacement computer on the same Windows machine.
limitations: This is not a second physical computer test.
Native UI automation was unavailable. The test used the same authenticated custom-scheme API as the restore button, without manipulating the DOM.
The real automatic upload was triggered by the client's automatic check. Timer interval boundaries were additionally covered by regression tests.

fixes: Upload 1 MiB chunks with a retry budget per chunk; reconcile committed offsets after a lost reply instead of restarting the whole archive.
Download at most 1 MiB per request with a fresh connection, 15-second idle timeout and transient-error retry.
privacy: Only hashes, counts and outcomes are included. No memory contents, credentials or database snapshots are committed.
